title: Ethos/commitment semantic wave
interpreter: running GPT-6 Codex agent; not GPT-5.6 Terra
physical_work_performed: Directly read cited evidence and performed the case analyses below; code only persists and hashes agent-authored results.

findings.claim: WVA identifies as Christian and says it serves irrespective of religion, race, ethnicity or gender; faith identity does not imply faith-restricted eligibility.
Plan prioritises girls' equality but explicitly says this does not exclude boys or men.
Caritas expresses Catholic inspiration alongside a commitment to all people regardless of religion, race or political beliefs.
WWF asserts ACFID adherence in a 2021 report and describes a public complaints route; neither assertion nor mechanism proves complaint-free conduct.
ACFID's revised Code was approved October 2023 and effective 30 June 2024; mapping to ACNC standards is alignment guidance, not equivalence or regulator accreditation.
Smith reports enhanced leave entitlements and ongoing DEI implementation; workplace aspiration and policy change do not establish all staff experience inclusiveness.
WVA supports First Nations self-determination, self-management and self-governance within a Christian acknowledgment; retain both elements.
ARC describes inclusion networks with over 200 registrations and a wellbeing strategy; registration counts are not a measure of achieved safety.
Caritas frames locally led action through subsidiarity and transformative partnerships, summarising evaluation learning; values and evidence roles coexist.
Plan commits to strengthening systematic resilience practice after evaluation recommendations; this is evidence of acknowledged improvement needs.

defects: D10: Code version dates and source assertion roles must survive donor projections.
counterexamples: Faith identity with explicit universal service commitment defeats eligibility inference from identity alone.
remaining_limitations: Requested Terra interpreter unavailable after session model switch; no second model/API invoked.
Ten pages interpreted; no independent conduct verification; Terra-specific requirement unmet.
